setup_failures.reason: GCC 14 sanitizer build rejected an Abseil constexpr function-pointer comparison
Clang C++23 configure probe failed before installing clang-tools-19; probe passed after scanner installation
C example linked with Clang C driver lacked C++ UBSan vptr runtime symbols; sanitizer workflow now builds the five executed C++ test targets

sampler_negative_checks: orphan child detected despite parent exit 0 and terminated

scope.hour_qualification: Each workload must run for at least 3600 seconds, retain its terminal PASS marker, exit 0, and have continuous resource samples with no watchdog or observed surviving child.
limitations: Finite loopback/simulated workloads, not proof of absence of all races or leaks.
No new real Android or physical serial acceptance.
Windows uses one-shot CLI in place of Unix PTY in the mixed workload.
Windows x86, Linux ARM64 and net48 have regular CI coverage, not hour workloads in this round.
No Windows sanitizer or Linux TSan hour coverage.
Child cleanup covers sampled child process identities; sub-sample short-lived children may not be observed.
Concurrent workloads and different host configurations are not a throughput comparison.
RSS includes runtime/allocator/sanitizer retention and does not alone measure live allocations.

interpretation.production_changes: None: no new confirmed library defect reproduced in this round; src/, include/ and bindings/ are unchanged from baseline.
interpretation.linux_live_log_delay: First Linux live page stopped updating at 240 seconds. Final artifacts contain 720 continuous samples for each workload (maximum interval <=5.017 s), all >=3600 s and exit 0; this was not a workload stall.
interpretation.sanitizer_rss: Standalone no-library 96000-thread-lifetime control also grows under ASan while Release stays stable. This establishes that sanitizer RSS growth can occur without this library, not that every byte of the main test RSS has been attributed.
interpretation.glibc_counters: mallinfo2 measures glibc allocated blocks, not all mappings. Its counters are not interpreted as live heap measurements under ASan interposition.
interpretation.managed_collection: Only wrapper pairs whose later GC check completed are counted; the last unchecked pair is excluded.

conclusion: No new confirmed library defect in the tested scope. All 11 hour workloads and follow-up regressions passed; sanitizer RSS growth is retained and qualified rather than described as zero growth.
